def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The diagonal 2s mark one residue class; the 6s fill the other
    # two classes in the repeating three-diagonal pattern.
    r0, c0 = next((r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2)
    residue = (c0 - r0) % 3
    return [[2 if (c-r) % 3 == residue else 6 for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
